The Columbia Flat Finisher Box - 10" is a professional finishing tool designed for the efficient application of joint compound to drywall butt joints and flat seams. This unit features a hinged pressure plate and a quick-release tab system, facilitating straightforward cleanup and maintenance between applications. The design incorporates an integrated door axle and pressure plate mechanism, which allows for smooth operation and precise compound metering to ensure consistent coverage across flat surfaces.

This 10-inch model is configured for both base and finish coating tasks. It includes a durable door plate wiper designed to resist expansion and deterioration during use. The tool is constructed with aluminum wheels featuring o-ring tires for smooth, reliable tracking. It is compatible with most leading brands of flat box handles, excluding the Tapeworm system, and can be operated with or without pressure plate springs due to the reduced drag of the integrated axle design.

This tool is engineered to provide a clean, consistent finish that is ready for painting, functioning effectively when used behind a corner roller or in conjunction with a corner box for efficient corner finishing.

This variation features a 2-inch working size, providing the necessary width for precise corner applications. The tool is constructed from U.S. billet aluminum and steel components, incorporating precision-set carbide blades and durable stainless steel wings. It comes equipped with a factory-installed wheel kit for smooth operation and utilizes a slide lock mechanism for secure attachment to compatible handles or applicator tools.

This 2.5-inch model features a durable construction utilizing U.S. billet aluminum and steel components. It is equipped with a pre-installed wheel kit and a slide-lock mechanism for secure attachment to compatible corner applicators or handles, allowing for efficient operation behind a corner roller or when skimming with a corner box.

The 2.5" Direct Flusher with Wheels from Columbia Taping Tools is designed for finishing narrow drywall angles and side legs with maximum precision and smooth operation.

The genuine stainless-steel runners will not rust or corrode, helping deliver a cleaner finish every time.

The superior locking retainer clip keeps the flusher securely attached to your handle, and it's compatible with any flusher or angle head handle, making it a versatile addition to any drywall finishing setup.

  • Wheel system helps eliminate skipping when using extension handles

  • Surgical stainless steel body resists flex and maintains precision

  • Solid billet machined core for durability and superior finishing results

  • Universal compatibility with flusher or angle head handles

  • Secure retainer clip keeps the tool firmly attached

2.5" Standard Corner Flusher

The 2.5" Standard Corner Flusher with Wheels from Columbia Taping Tools is designed to deliver a smooth, consistent finish when applying base coats to drywall corners. The integrated wheel system reduces friction and ensures the flusher glides easily along the joint, providing one of the smoothest runs available for professional taping tools.

Precision-machined with a solid billet aluminum core and a surgical stainless steel body, this flusher maintains its shape and accuracy even after heavy, long-term use. The stainless steel runners resist rust and corrosion, helping produce clean, professional corner finishes every time.

The built-in locking retainer clip securely attaches the flusher to the handle and is compatible with most angle head or flusher handles, giving contractors flexibility on the job site.

FEATURES:

  • Wheel system reduces friction by up to 80% for smoother operation

  • Integrated wheels minimize skipping, especially when used with extension handles

  • Surgical stainless steel body resists flexing and maintains precision

  • Solid billet core construction for durability and longer tool life

  • Universal compatibility with flusher or angle head handles

  • Secure locking retainer clip keeps the flusher firmly attached

  • Rust-resistant stainless steel runners for a cleaner finish

The Columbia Angle Head - 3" is a professional finishing tool designed to wipe and feather joint compound on both sides of internal drywall corners. Engineered for high-performance finishing, this tool is used to achieve a smooth, consistent finish that is ready for paint, whether operating behind a corner roller or following a corner applicator box.

This 3-inch variation features durable stainless steel wings and precision-set carbide blades to ensure clean, uniform results. The unit is constructed from U.S. billet aluminum and steel components, machined in Canada. It arrives with a wheel kit pre-installed and includes an Allen key to facilitate easy removal and maintenance, along with a slide lock mechanism for secure attachment to your finishing handles.

The Columbia 3" Combo Corner Flusher is designed to embed and feather joint tape into pre-filled internal 90° drywall corners. Its compact 3" size makes it an excellent choice for taping coats in tight areas, such as narrow door and window legs.

Built for durability and precision, the tool features a solid billet-machined core for maximum accuracy and long service life. The surgical-grade stainless steel body resists flexing and maintains its shape even after extensive use. Genuine stainless-steel runners resist rust and corrosion, helping deliver a consistently clean finish.

The flusher includes a superior locking retainer clip that securely attaches the tool to the handle during use.

  • Designed for embedding and feathering tape in 90° drywall corners

  • Surgical stainless-steel body for durability and reduced flex

  • Solid billet-machined core for precision and longer life

  • Stainless steel runners resist rust and corrosion

  • Superior locking clip keeps the flusher securely attached

3" Direct Flusher

The 3" Direct Flusher with Wheels from Columbia Taping Tools is designed for finishing narrow drywall angles and side legs with maximum precision and smooth operation.

The integrated wheel system reduces friction by up to 80%, allowing the flusher to glide effortlessly along the joint. This minimizes drag and helps eliminate skipping—especially when used with extension handles.

Built for durability and accuracy, the tool features a solid billet machined core that ensures long service life and a consistently smooth finish. The surgical-grade stainless steel body resists flexing and maintains its true shape even after heavy professional use.

The genuine stainless-steel runners will not rust or corrode, helping deliver a cleaner finish every time.

The superior locking retainer clip keeps the flusher securely attached to your handle, and it's compatible with any flusher or angle head handle, making it a versatile addition to any drywall finishing setup.

FEATURES:

  • Wheels reduce friction by up to 80% for smoother operation

  • Wheel system helps eliminate skipping when using extension handles

  • Surgical stainless steel body resists flex and maintains precision

  • Solid billet machined core for durability and superior finishing results

  • Universal compatibility with flusher or angle head handles

  • Secure retainer clip keeps the tool firmly attached

3" Standard Corner Flusher

The 3" Standard Corner Flusher with Wheels from Columbia Taping Tools is designed to deliver a smooth, consistent finish when applying base coats to drywall corners. The integrated wheel system reduces friction and ensures the flusher glides easily along the joint, providing one of the smoothest runs available for professional taping tools.

Precision-machined with a solid billet aluminum core and a surgical stainless steel body, this flusher maintains its shape and accuracy even after heavy, long-term use. The stainless steel runners resist rust and corrosion, helping produce clean, professional corner finishes every time.

The built-in locking retainer clip securely attaches the flusher to the handle and is compatible with most angle head or flusher handles, giving contractors flexibility on the job site.

FEATURES:

  • Wheel system reduces friction by up to 80% for smoother operation

  • Integrated wheels minimize skipping, especially when used with extension handles

  • Surgical stainless steel body resists flexing and maintains precision

  • Solid billet core construction for durability and longer tool life

  • Universal compatibility with flusher or angle head handles

  • Secure locking retainer clip keeps the flusher firmly attached

  • Rust-resistant stainless steel runners for a cleaner finish
dtb_value:
The Columbia Standard Flusher - 3" is a professional-grade tool designed for finishing internal drywall corners. As part of the Columbia Standard Flusher line, this tool is engineered to wipe and feather joint compound, providing a consistent finish in 90-degree interior corners during the finishing stages of drywall installation.

This 3-inch variation is precision-machined from U.S. aluminum and steel components at the Columbia Tools facility in Canada. Each unit is hand-ground and verified on a granite plate to ensure quality. The tool includes wheels for operation and an Allen key for users who prefer to adjust or remove the wheel assembly based on their specific finishing workflow.

3.5" Combo Corner Flusher 

The Columbia 3.5" Combo Corner Flusher is designed to embed and feather joint tape into pre-filled internal 90° drywall corners. Its compact 3.5" size makes it an excellent choice for taping coats in tight areas, such as narrow door and window legs.

Built for durability and precision, the tool features a solid billet-machined core for maximum accuracy and long service life. The surgical-grade stainless steel body resists flexing and maintains its shape even after extensive use. Genuine stainless-steel runners resist rust and corrosion, helping deliver a consistently clean finish.

The flusher includes a superior locking retainer clip that securely attaches the tool to the handle during use. 

FEATURES:

  • Designed for embedding and feathering tape in 90° drywall corners

  • Surgical stainless-steel body for durability and reduced flex

  • Solid billet-machined core for precision and longer life

  • Stainless steel runners resist rust and corrosion

  • Superior locking clip keeps the flusher securely attached

The Columbia 3.5" Combo Corner Flusher is designed to embed and feather joint tape into pre-filled internal 90° drywall corners. Its compact 3.5" size makes it an excellent choice for taping coats in tight areas, such as narrow door and window legs.

Built for durability and precision, the tool features a solid billet-machined core for maximum accuracy and long service life. The surgical-grade stainless steel body resists flexing and maintains its shape even after extensive use. Genuine stainless-steel runners resist rust and corrosion, helping deliver a consistently clean finish.

The flusher includes a superior locking retainer clip that securely attaches the tool to the handle during use.

The 3.5" Direct Flusher with Wheels from Columbia Taping Tools is designed for finishing narrow drywall angles and side legs with maximum precision and smooth operation.

The integrated wheel system reduces friction by up to 80%, allowing the flusher to glide effortlessly along the joint. This minimizes drag and helps eliminate skipping—especially when used with extension handles.

Built for durability and accuracy, the tool features a solid billet machined core that ensures long service life and a consistently smooth finish. The surgical-grade stainless steel body resists flexing and maintains its true shape even after heavy professional use.

The genuine stainless-steel runners will not rust or corrode, helping deliver a cleaner finish every time.

The superior locking retainer clip keeps the flusher securely attached to your handle, and it's compatible with any flusher or angle head handle, making it a versatile addition to any drywall finishing setup.

FEATURES

  • Wheels reduce friction by up to 80% for smoother operation

  • Wheel system helps eliminate skipping when using extension handles

  • Surgical stainless steel body resists flex and maintains precision

  • Solid billet machined core for durability and superior finishing results

  • Universal compatibility with flusher or angle head handles

  • Secure retainer clip keeps the tool firmly attached

The 4" Direct Flusher with Wheels from Columbia Taping Tools is designed for finishing narrow drywall angles and side legs with maximum precision and smooth operation.

The integrated wheel system reduces friction by up to 80%, allowing the flusher to glide effortlessly along the joint. This minimizes drag and helps eliminate skipping—especially when used with extension handles.

Built for durability and accuracy, the tool features a solid billet machined core that ensures long service life and a consistently smooth finish. The surgical-grade stainless steel body resists flexing and maintains its true shape even after heavy professional use.

The genuine stainless-steel runners will not rust or corrode, helping deliver a cleaner finish every time.

The superior locking retainer clip keeps the flusher securely attached to your handle, and it's compatible with any flusher or angle head handle, making it a versatile addition to any drywall finishing setup.

  • Surgical stainless steel body resists flex and maintains precision

  • Solid billet machined core for durability and superior finishing results

  • Universal compatibility with flusher or angle head handles

  • Secure retainer clip keeps the tool firmly attached

4" Standard Corner Flusher

The 4" Standard Corner Flusher with Wheels from Columbia Taping Tools is designed to deliver a smooth, consistent finish when applying base coats to drywall corners. The integrated wheel system reduces friction and ensures the flusher glides easily along the joint, providing one of the smoothest runs available for professional taping tools.

Precision-machined with a solid billet aluminum core and a surgical stainless-steel body, this flusher maintains its shape and accuracy even after heavy, long-term use. The stainless-steel runners resist rust and corrosion, helping produce clean, professional corner finishes every time.

The built-in locking retainer clip securely attaches the flusher to the handle and is compatible with most angle head or flusher handles, giving contractors flexibility on the job site.

FEATURES:

  • Wheel system reduces friction by up to 80% for smoother operation

  • Integrated wheels minimize skipping, especially when used with extension handles

  • Surgical stainless steel body resists flexing and maintains precision

  • Solid billet core construction for durability and longer tool life

  • Universal compatibility with flusher or angle head handles

  • Secure locking retainer clip keeps the flusher firmly attached

  • Rust-resistant stainless-steel runners for a cleaner finish

Columbia’s 5' 180 Grip Flat Box Handle delivers extended reach with a fully articulating 180‑degree grip head for smooth, controlled finishing across tall walls and ceilings. The Columbia 180° Grip Flat Box Handle - 5' is a professional-grade finishing tool designed for use with automatic flat boxes. This handle provides the necessary leverage and control for applying joint compound to flat and butt joints, featuring a specialized 180-degree rotating grip mechanism that allows the handle to pivot freely in the user's hand to maintain a natural, ergonomic alignment during the finishing stroke.

This 5-foot configuration is optimized for reaching standard ceiling heights and upper wall sections, reducing the need for constant repositioning of stilts or benches. Constructed from high-strength aluminum, the handle offers a rigid, lightweight interface that ensures consistent pressure is applied to the finishing box for a uniform coat. The unit is finished with an anodized coating to resist corrosion and facilitate easier cleanup of dried joint compound.

The handle is constructed from lightweight, rigid aluminum to maintain structural integrity and steady box control throughout the stroke.

The Columbia Taping Tools 7" Throttle Box Drywall Finishing Corner Box is designed to help professional drywall finishers quickly and consistently finish inside corners. Engineered for efficiency and control, the 7" Throttle Box delivers a smooth application of joint compound while helping produce clean, professional-looking inside corners.

Designed for use with professional drywall finishing systems, the Throttle Box helps streamline the corner-finishing process and reduce the time and effort required for manual finishing. Its 7" size provides an efficient working width for applying compound evenly along inside corners.

Consistent Corners. Faster Finishing.

Inside corners can be one of the most time-consuming parts of drywall finishing. The Columbia 7" Throttle Box is designed to make the process faster and more consistent by applying joint compound evenly as you work along the corner.

The result is a more efficient finishing process that helps professional crews maintain consistent results across the entire project.

Key Features

  • 7" Finishing Box – Designed specifically for finishing inside drywall corners.
  • Consistent Compound Application – Helps apply joint compound evenly along the corner for a uniform finish.
  • Throttle Control – Provides control over compound flow for more precise corner finishing.
  • Professional Corner Finishing – Designed to help create clean, consistent inside corners.
  • Improved Productivity – Helps reduce the time and effort required for manual corner finishing.
  • Easy to Control – Designed for smooth, controlled movement along inside corners.
  • Professional-Grade Construction – Built for the demands of daily drywall finishing.
  • Built for Finishers – Ideal for professional drywall contractors, tapers, and high-production finishing crews.

Take the Work Out of Corner Finishing

The Columbia 7" Throttle Box is designed to make inside-corner finishing faster and more consistent. Instead of relying solely on a hand tool to apply and spread compound, the corner box helps deliver a controlled amount of material as you work.

It's an efficient addition to any professional drywall finishing setup and is especially valuable on projects where speed and consistency matter.

Load it. Throttle it. Finish it.

The Columbia Taping Tools Difference

Columbia Taping Tools designs professional drywall taping and finishing equipment around the needs of contractors and finishers. The 7" Throttle Box combines controlled compound application with an efficient corner-finishing design to help professionals work faster and achieve consistent results.

From residential projects to high-production commercial work, the Columbia 7" Throttle Box is built to help make inside-corner finishing more efficient.

Engineered for efficiency and control, the 7" Throttle Box delivers a smooth application of joint compound while helping produce clean, professional-looking inside corners.

Designed for use with professional drywall finishing systems, the Throttle Box helps streamline the corner-finishing process and reduce the time and effort required for manual finishing. Its 7" size provides an efficient working width for applying compound evenly along inside corners.

Consistent Corners. Faster Finishing.

Inside corners can be one of the most time-consuming parts of drywall finishing. The Columbia 7" Throttle Box is designed to make the process faster and more consistent by applying joint compound evenly as you work along the corner.

The result is a more efficient finishing process that helps professional crews maintain consistent results across the entire project.

Key Features

  • 7" Finishing Box – Designed specifically for finishing inside drywall corners.
  • Consistent Compound Application – Helps apply joint compound evenly along the corner for a uniform finish.
  • Throttle Control – Provides control over compound flow for more precise corner finishing.
  • Professional Corner Finishing – Designed to help create clean, consistent inside corners.
  • Improved Productivity – Helps reduce the time and effort required for manual corner finishing.
  • Easy to Control – Designed for smooth, controlled movement along inside corners.
  • Professional-Grade Construction – Built for the demands of daily drywall finishing.
  • Built for Finishers – Ideal for professional drywall contractors, tapers, and high-production finishing crews.

Take the Work Out of Corner Finishing

The Columbia 7" Throttle Box is designed to make inside-corner finishing faster and more consistent. Instead of relying solely on a hand tool to apply and spread compound, the corner box helps deliver a controlled amount of material as you work.

It's an efficient addition to any professional drywall finishing setup and is especially valuable on projects where speed and consistency matter.

Load it. Throttle it. Finish it.

The Columbia Taping Tools Difference

Columbia Taping Tools designs professional drywall taping and finishing equipment around the needs of contractors and finishers. The 7" Throttle Box combines controlled compound application with an efficient corner-finishing design to help professionals work faster and achieve consistent results.

From residential projects to high-production commercial work, the Columbia 7" Throttle Box is built to help make inside-corner finishing more efficient.

Professional control. Consistent corners. Faster finishing.

The Columbia Taping Tools 7" Throttle Box — designed to make inside-corner finishing easier and more productive.

Columbia offers the widest range of high-quality Finishing Boxes in the world. The Automatic Flat Boxes reduce the need to push the compound on to the wall. By engaging, the box springs put pressure on the compound chamber requiring only a light push to operate the box. Well-built and fine-tuned to offer great flat joints for years. We have been told for years that our boxes are the smoothest finishing and easiest to push. We are very proud to get this feedback and will make sure that every Finishing Box we make exceeds your expectations.

Note: Columbia Automatic Boxes do not fit in Road Case.

FEATURES:

  • Available in 8″, 10″, 12″ & 14″ regular and 8″, 10″ & 12″ Fat Boy sizes
  • Engaging axel creates pressure on mud release
  • Over 50% easier to push
  • Great for vertical flats
  • Bead wheel protects axel from wear while running box on bead
  • Hand made from U.S. billet aluminum and steel components
  • Machined in our state-of-the-art facility in Canada

The Columbia Automatic Flat Box - 8" is a professional finishing tool designed to apply and feather joint compound over taped flat and butt joints. This automatic-assist finishing box provides precision compound metering, allowing for consistent coverage and high-quality surface finishes on drywall seams.

This 8-inch model features a spring-loaded axle and an integrated pressure plate system, which work together to reduce the manual force required during operation. The tool is constructed with a durable door plate wiper designed to resist expansion and deterioration, and includes a finger pull on the pressure door to facilitate efficient filling via a loading pump.

The Columbia Automatic Taper - Standard 53" is a precision-engineered tool designed for professional drywall taping applications. It is built to apply both joint compound and drywall tape simultaneously along wall and ceiling joints, streamlining the taping process for flats and internal angles. The tool features a hard-anodized tube construction to maintain performance and prevent track lines, while stainless steel side plates, creaser arms, and cable drum provide long-term corrosion resistance.

This standard 53-inch model is designed for reach and efficiency, incorporating a patent-pending pump action sleeve for smooth tape cutting. It includes an adjustable brake and a quick-release mechanism for efficient tape changes, along with a quick-release cap for simplified cleaning. The tool is constructed from U.S. billet aluminum and steel components, ensuring a durable build for consistent use on the jobsite.

The Columbia Taping Tools One Extendable Handle 3'–5' gives professional drywall finishers the adjustable reach they need to work more efficiently on walls, ceilings, and hard-to-reach areas. With a telescoping design that extends from 3 feet to 5 feet, this versatile handle lets you adjust your working length to match the job.

Designed for professional drywall taping and finishing applications, the One Extendable Handle provides additional reach while helping reduce unnecessary climbing, stretching, and repositioning. Quickly adjust the handle to the desired length and get the control and access you need to keep the job moving.

One Handle. Multiple Applications.

Different areas of a job require different working lengths. The Columbia One Extendable Handle gives you the flexibility to shorten the handle when working in tighter spaces or extend it when additional reach is needed.

The adjustable design makes it a versatile addition to a professional drywall finishing setup, particularly when working on ceilings, upper wall sections, and other difficult-to-reach areas.

Key Features

  • Adjustable 3'–5' Length – Extends to provide additional reach when you need it and retracts for improved maneuverability.
  • Extendable Design – Quickly adjust the working length to suit different applications and working conditions.
  • Improved Reach – Helps access ceilings, upper walls, and hard-to-reach areas with less stretching and repositioning.
  • Better Control – Provides a comfortable and controlled way to operate compatible taping and finishing tools.
  • Versatile Performance – One adjustable handle can accommodate a variety of professional drywall finishing applications.
  • Jobsite Ready – Designed for the demands of professional drywall contractors and finishers.
  • Columbia Quality – Built as part of the Columbia Taping Tools professional drywall finishing system.

Reach Further. Work Smarter.

The Columbia One Extendable Handle gives finishers the flexibility to change their reach as the job changes. From standard-height walls to higher ceilings, the 3'–5' adjustable range helps you work more efficiently without constantly switching between different-length handles.

Spend less time reaching, climbing, and repositioning—and more time getting the finish right.

The Columbia Taping Tools Difference

Columbia Taping Tools designs professional drywall taping and finishing equipment around the real-world needs of contractors. The One Extendable Handle combines adjustable reach with practical jobsite versatility, giving professionals one handle that can adapt to a wide range of applications.

3' to 5' of adjustable reach. One professional solution.

The Columbia Corner Cobra is a specialized rolling tool designed to set structural corner beads, including No-Coat 350 and 425 as well as standard paper tapes. Engineered for versatility, this tool functions on both inside and outside angles ranging from 85 to 180 degrees.

The unit features an integrated adaptive suspension system with shocks that accommodate framing irregularities and imperfect wall settings, ensuring consistent pressure during the rolling process. It is designed to track the center and outside edges of the bead, leaving only a clean knife-feather finish. Constructed from U.S. billet aluminum and steel components, the tool is machined in Canada and is compatible with standard corner roller handles.

Inside Corner Roller

Our Inside Corner Roller offers the easiest roll in the industry. With our split wheel design tapes do not drag upon initial contact. The tape immediately imbeds in the corner with all unneeded compound being pushed out from behind.

FEATURES:

  • Innovative split wheel design
  • Cast aluminum body
  • Hand made from U.S. aluminum and steel components
  • Machined in our state-of-the-art facility in Canada
dtb_value:
The Columbia Corner Roller is a professional-grade tool designed for the tape-embedding stage of internal corner finishing. It features a specialized split-wheel design that allows the roller to track accurately within 90-degree internal angles, ensuring tape is firmly seated into the joint compound. By utilizing this mechanism, the tool helps displace excess compound from behind the tape, promoting a secure bond and a clean finish.

Constructed with a durable cast aluminum body, this tool is engineered for consistent performance on the jobsite. It is manufactured using U.S.-sourced aluminum and steel components, with machining completed in Canada. The design prioritizes ease of use and effective tape seating, serving as a critical component in automatic-tool drywall finishing workflows.

This standard-length gooseneck is constructed with a TIG-welded stainless steel frame for durability and features a rubber-coated horseshoe design to protect the taper during the filling process. Each unit is handcrafted in Canada using U.S. billet aluminum and steel components, providing a robust and reliable tool for daily jobsite use.

The Columbia Taping Tools 2-Wheel Inside Corner Applicator is designed for smooth, controlled application of drywall compound into internal corners. Its compact two-wheel design provides excellent maneuverability and control, making it especially well suited for tight spaces, detailed work, and areas where a more streamlined applicator is preferred.

Precision-machined from solid aluminum billet, the applicator delivers the strength and durability required for everyday professional use while maintaining a lightweight, easy-to-handle design. Durable Delrin wheels allow the applicator to glide smoothly along drywall surfaces while helping maintain consistent positioning and compound application throughout the corner.

Whether you're working in confined areas or handling everyday inside corner applications, the 2-Wheel Inside Corner Applicator provides professional finishers with a simple, precise, and efficient way to apply compound.

Key Features

  • Two-wheel design for increased control and maneuverability

  • Designed for smooth, consistent compound application in inside corners

  • Compact design is ideal for tight spaces and detailed applications

  • Precision-machined from solid aluminum billet

  • Durable Delrin wheels provide a smooth, consistent glide

  • Helps provide even and controlled compound application

  • Lightweight design for comfortable handling

  • Built for professional drywall taping and finishing

  • Constructed using high-quality U.S. aluminum and steel components

  • Manufactured in a state-of-the-art facility in Canada

The Columbia Taping Tools 4-Wheel Inside Corner Applicator is engineered for smooth, controlled application of drywall compound into internal corners. Designed for professional finishers, its four-wheel configuration provides excellent stability and helps guide the applicator smoothly along the corner for consistent compound placement.

Precision-machined from solid aluminum billet, the applicator combines strength, durability, and accuracy for demanding jobsite use. Durable Delrin wheels provide a smooth glide along drywall surfaces while helping maintain proper positioning throughout the application.

Whether you're working on residential projects or high-volume commercial finishing, the 4-Wheel Inside Corner Applicator provides the control and consistency needed to apply compound quickly and efficiently before the finishing stage.

Key Features

  • Four-wheel design provides increased stability and control

  • Designed for smooth, consistent compound application in inside corners

  • Precision-machined from solid aluminum billet

  • Durable Delrin wheels provide a smooth glide along drywall surfaces

  • Helps maintain consistent positioning through the corner

  • Built for professional drywall taping and finishing

  • Constructed using high-quality U.S. aluminum and steel components

  • Manufactured in a state-of-the-art facility in Canada

The Columbia Taping Tools One Extendable Handle Long 4'–8' gives professional drywall finishers the extended reach needed to work more efficiently on high walls, ceilings, and hard-to-reach areas. With an adjustable length from 4 feet to 8 feet, this long-reach handle provides the flexibility to adapt to different working conditions without constantly switching tools.

Designed for professional drywall taping and finishing applications, the One Extendable Handle Long helps reduce stretching, climbing, and repositioning while providing the reach and control needed to get the job done efficiently.

Eight Feet of Reach When You Need It

High ceilings and tall walls can make finishing applications more challenging. The One Extendable Handle Long gives you the ability to extend your reach up to 8 feet, helping you access elevated areas while keeping your feet on the ground.

When additional reach isn't required, simply adjust the handle to a shorter length for improved control and maneuverability.

Key Features

  • Adjustable 4'–8' Length – Provides a wide range of adjustable reach for different applications.
  • Long-Reach Design – Extends up to 8 feet to help access high walls and ceilings.
  • Adjustable Working Length – Set the handle to the length that best suits the job.
  • Reduced Climbing & Stretching – Helps reach elevated areas while keeping you on the ground.
  • Improved Access – Ideal for high ceilings, upper wall sections, and difficult-to-reach areas.
  • Versatile Performance – One handle adapts to multiple working heights and applications.
  • Professional Jobsite Design – Built for professional drywall contractors and finishers.
  • Columbia Quality – Designed as part of the Columbia Taping Tools professional finishing system.

More Reach. Less Repositioning.

When the job takes you higher, the Columbia One Extendable Handle Long gives you the reach to follow. The adjustable 4'–8' design lets you quickly adapt to the height of the work area while maintaining the control and maneuverability needed for professional finishing.

From tall walls to high ceilings, extend your reach without constantly climbing or repositioning.

The Columbia Taping Tools Difference

At Columbia Taping Tools, we develop professional drywall taping and finishing equipment designed to make the job more efficient. The One Extendable Handle Long provides the additional reach professionals need while maintaining the versatility of an adjustable handle.

The Columbia Taping Tools One Extendable 3'–5' Predator Carbon Fiber Handle combines adjustable reach with lightweight carbon fiber construction to give professional drywall finishers greater flexibility, control, and comfort on the jobsite.

Designed specifically for the Columbia Predator taping system, this extendable handle adjusts from 3 feet to 5 feet, allowing you to quickly change your working length to match the application. Extend the handle when additional reach is needed or shorten it for greater control and maneuverability in tighter spaces.

Lightweight Reach. Professional Control.

The carbon fiber construction provides an excellent combination of lightweight performance, strength, and rigidity. This helps keep the handle easy to maneuver while providing the solid, responsive feel professionals expect from their taping equipment.

With a 3'–5' adjustable range, one handle can adapt to different working conditions without requiring multiple fixed-length handles.

Key Features

  • Adjustable 3'–5' Length – Customize your working reach to suit the application.
  • Carbon Fiber Construction – Lightweight, strong, and rigid for professional use.
  • Designed for the Predator System – Purpose-built for compatible Columbia Predator taping equipment.
  • Extended Reach – Provides additional reach for ceilings, upper walls, and other applications.
  • Improved Maneuverability – Retract the handle when working in tighter areas or when greater control is needed.
  • Lightweight Performance – Helps reduce unnecessary weight for more comfortable extended use.
  • Excellent Control – Carbon fiber rigidity provides a responsive feel while operating your taping tool.
  • Professional-Grade Design – Built for drywall contractors, professional tapers, and finishing crews.

One Handle That Adapts to the Job

Different applications require different levels of reach. The One Extendable Predator Carbon Fiber Handle gives you the flexibility to adjust your tool as the job changes.

At 3 feet, the handle provides a compact, controlled setup. Extend it to 5 feet when you need additional reach for ceilings and elevated areas.

Extend when you need reach. Retract when you need control.

The Columbia Taping Tools Difference

Columbia Taping Tools develops professional drywall taping and finishing equipment designed around the demands of the trade. The One Extendable Predator Carbon Fiber Handle combines the versatility of adjustable length with the lightweight performance of carbon fiber to create a handle that's ready for a wide range of professional applications.

Built with a high-performance carbon fiber barrel, the Predator delivers exceptional strength while significantly reducing weight compared to traditional metal loading pumps.

Designed for efficient loading of automatic tapers, finishing boxes, and other drywall finishing tools, the Predator helps contractors spend less time at the mud box and more time finishing the job.

Built for the Professional

The Predator combines Columbia Taping Tools’ commitment to professional-grade performance with advanced carbon fiber construction. Its lightweight design helps reduce fatigue during repetitive loading, while the rigid carbon fiber barrel provides the durability needed to withstand demanding jobsite conditions.

Whether you're working on a large commercial project or a residential finish, the Predator is designed to keep your tools loaded and your workflow moving.

  • Carbon Fiber Barrel – Lightweight, rigid, and exceptionally durable for professional jobsite use.

  • Smooth Operation – Designed for consistent compound delivery and reliable performance.
  • Professional-Grade Construction – Built to withstand the demands of daily drywall finishing.
  • Ergonomic Design – Comfortable handling helps improve efficiency throughout the workday.
  • Made for Drywall Professionals – Ideal for contractors, tapers, finishers, and high-production crews.

Whether you're working on a large commercial project or a residential finish, the Predator is designed to keep your tools loaded and your workflow moving.

Key Features

  • Carbon Fiber Barrel – Lightweight, rigid, and exceptionally durable for professional jobsite use.
  • Reduced Weight – Helps minimize arm and shoulder fatigue during extended use.
  • High-Capacity Loading – Quickly and efficiently loads drywall finishing tools with less downtime.
  • Smooth Operation – Designed for consistent compound delivery and reliable performance.
  • Professional-Grade Construction – Built to withstand the demands of daily drywall finishing.
  • Ergonomic Design – Comfortable handling helps improve efficiency throughout the workday.
  • Made for Drywall Professionals – Ideal for contractors, tapers, finishers, and high-production crews.

The Complete Introduction to Semi-Automatic Drywall Finishing

Ready to step up from traditional hand tools? The Columbia Taping Tools Commando Set takes the guesswork out of making the move to semi-automatic drywall tools. Designed as a complete introduction to semi-automatic finishing, the Commando Set is an excellent choice for part-time finishers, contractors looking to improve productivity, or professionals who want to experience the benefits of semi-automatic tools before making the move to a full automatic system.

The Commando Set includes the essential tools needed for applying and finishing drywall compound, including standard flushers, a compound mud tube, extendible and fixed handles, angle and flat applicator heads, a two-way internal corner applicator, and a corner roller head.

Semi-automatic tools help reduce repetitive hand work and can save valuable time on the job while delivering a consistent, professional finish. The combination of tools in the Commando Set gives you the versatility to tackle a wide range of drywall finishing applications with one complete system.

Everything comes packed in a convenient Semi-Automatic Case, making it easy to store, organize, protect, and transport your tools to and from the jobsite.

SET INCLUDES:

  • Semi-Automatic Case
  • 2.5" Standard Flusher (2.5SF)
  • 3" Standard Flusher (3SF)
  • 42" Compound Mud Tube (CMT42)
  • Columbia One Extendible Handle 3'–5' (C1HEXT)
  • Columbia One Fixed Handle (C1H)
  • Angle Head Adapter (AHA)
  • Flat Applicator Head (CFLT)
  • Two-Way Internal Applicator (ICATW)
  • Corner Roller Head (CR)

The Commando Set gives you the essential semi-automatic tools needed to increase productivity without requiring a complete transition to automatic equipment. By combining compound application, flat finishing, and corner finishing tools into one system, the Commando Set helps reduce repetitive work and makes it easier to achieve consistent results.

Whether you're a part-time finisher looking for a more efficient way to work or an experienced drywall professional ready to explore semi-automatic tools, the Columbia Commando Set provides a practical and versatile introduction to the Columbia semi-automatic system.

  • Includes tools for flat joints, inside corners, and finishing applications
  • Helps reduce repetitive hand work and save time on the job
  • Designed for consistent compound application and finishing
  • Includes both fixed and adjustable handles

The Columbia Taping Tools Semi-Auto Taper is designed to help professional drywall finishers apply drywall tape and joint compound quickly and consistently. Combining efficient tape application with hands-on control, the Semi-Auto Taper helps streamline the taping process while giving finishers the control they need for professional results.

Ideal for drywall contractors, tapers, and finishing crews, the Columbia Semi-Auto Taper is built to improve productivity while reducing the time and effort required for traditional hand taping.

Key Features

  • Semi-Automatic Operation – Streamlines tape and compound application while maintaining excellent control.
  • Efficient Tape Application – Applies drywall tape and joint compound in a smooth, continuous operation.
  • Consistent Compound Coverage – Helps provide even compound beneath the tape for professional results.
  • Improved Productivity – Helps reduce the time and effort required for traditional taping.
  • Professional Control – Designed to give finishers precise control throughout the taping process.
  • Professional-Grade Construction – Built for demanding drywall taping applications.
  • Versatile Performance – Ideal for residential, commercial, remodeling, and repair projects.
dtb_value:
The Columbia Semi Automatic Taper, often referred to as a bucket taper, is designed to streamline the drywall taping process by applying a measured amount of joint compound to a volume of tape directly from a compound bucket. This tool provides a consistent application method for drywall joints, offering an alternative to manual taping methods.

The unit features an integrated tape spool equipped with a brake mechanism to assist in controlling tape dispensing during use. For operational clarity, the tool includes laser-engraved instructions directly on the door. The Columbia Semi Automatic Taper is constructed from U.S. billet aluminum and steel components, and is manufactured in Canada.

The Columbia Semi-Automatic Tool Case is designed to provide secure storage and transport for a complete set of Columbia semi-automatic finishing tools. Engineered for durability, this case features an interior lined with eggshell foam that holds tools firmly in place when the unit is latched. In addition to semi-automatic tool sets, the case is suitable for storing Columbia Tomahawk Smoothing Blades up to 40 inches in length.

The construction includes four lockable latches to ensure the case remains closed during transport. It is built with a combination of piano-style and brass hinges to provide structural reliability. This case is manufactured in North America and is specifically configured for semi-automatic equipment; it is not intended for use with automatic tools.

Its extended barrel provides increased compound capacity while maintaining the control and handling professional finishers expect from Columbia Taping Tools.

From large commercial projects to demanding residential jobs, the Tall Boy is built to help you load faster, refill less, and finish more.

Columbia Taping Tools develops professional drywall finishing equipment with one goal in mind: helping drywall professionals work faster, easier, and more efficiently.

The Tall Boy Loading Pump is a dependable addition to any professional taping and finishing setup, delivering the capacity, performance, and jobsite durability needed to get the job done right.

More compound. Less downtime. More productivity.

manufacturer_value:
The Columbia Taping Tools ICATW Two-Way Internal Corner Applicator is designed to make applying drywall compound to inside corners faster, smoother, and more efficient. Its unique two-way design allows the applicator to travel in either direction along the corner, giving professional finishers greater flexibility and control without having to constantly reposition the tool.

Featuring a four-wheel configuration, the ICATW tracks smoothly along the wall while helping maintain consistent positioning and compound distribution throughout the corner. The precision-machined Delrin wheels provide a smooth glide, making it easier to achieve controlled, consistent application from one end of the corner to the other.

The ICATW is precision-machined from solid aluminum billet for the durability and accuracy required for professional drywall finishing. Designed to integrate with Columbia's semi-automatic compound application system, it pairs with a Columbia Compound Tube to efficiently deliver compound directly to internal corners.

Whether you're running vertical corners, horizontal angles, or working through high-volume production, the two-way design allows you to work efficiently in either direction while maintaining smooth compound application.

Key Features

  • Two-way design allows operation in either direction

  • Four-wheel configuration for smooth, controlled movement

  • Designed for applying drywall compound to internal corners

  • Precision-machined from solid aluminum billet

  • Delrin wheels provide a smooth glide along drywall surfaces

  • Helps provide consistent compound distribution

  • Works with Columbia Compound Tubes

  • Reduces unnecessary repositioning while working corners

  • Handcrafted using high-quality U.S. aluminum and steel components

  • Machined in Columbia's state-of-the-art facility in Canada

  • Designed for professional drywall taping and finishing
